User talk:Crashdemons
First of all, welcome to Uncovering Cicada.
I don't know from where inside your ass you pulled the number 3319, but 3319 is just the word ID for anarchist on latin-dictionary.
As for 3301 being anonymous, those who know don't tell and those who tell don't know. Claims about 3301's identity are unverifiable at best. There is no supporting evidence to back any of them up.
Pay no attention to the man behind the curtain. It is not our job and certainly not our place to dox 3301. If 3301 wishes to keep their identity hidden, it is our responsibility to respect that.
Please feel free to read the [http://uncovering-cicada.wikia.com/wiki/FAQ FAQ] and What Happened pages(starting at [http://uncovering-cicada.wikia.com/wiki/What_Happened_Part_1_(2012) 2012- part one])
Happy solving! [[User:Ctvrty|Ctvrty]] ([[User talk:Ctvrty|talk]]) 13:56, January 11, 2018 (UTC)

Proverb

3 puta kojim čovek može ići, 3 načina da se noću zaspi, može biti  nijedan, ili samo jedan... it's a Christianity (orthodox) saying... 3 (also a holy number) ways a man can take- God, Satan and something else (that's not true), also that for 3 ways to fall asleep (as a follower of good, evil, or being spiritually blind... there can be either none or one- you can be an unbeliever, or believe in just one thing (reference to those who believe in multiple things (for example destiny, karma, mother Earth... at the same time)- they are considered truly lost)... Oh and, it's a saying among a group of people in the northern part of my country. My origins are from there, and my great-grandfathers peers used to say that. They have a sort of guild. Entrepreneurs all of them, also landowners. Hvala.
